# Software

<p class="lede">Web applications, pipelines, R packages and tutorials, from clinical mitochondrial genetics to scheduling and field-guide keys. Most are on <a href="https://github.com/leipzig">GitHub</a>.</p>

<a class="sw-card" href="../rhylthyme/">
  <div class="sw-card__media"><img src="../assets/thumbs/software/rhylthyme.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></div>
  <div class="sw-card__body">
    <p class="eyebrow"><span>Python · 2025</span></p>
    <h3>Rhylthyme <span class="badge">Case study</span></h3>
    <p>A JSON-based markup language and toolchain for describing real-time programs that coordinate parallel tracks of work with resource constraints, timing dependencies, and flexible execution patterns. Includes a CLI runner, web visualizer, and MCP server for AI-assisted schedule generation.</p>
  </div>
</a>
<a class="sw-card" href="https://leipzig.github.io/dimoose/">
  <div class="sw-card__media"><img src="../assets/thumbs/software/dimoose.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></div>
  <div class="sw-card__body">
    <p class="eyebrow"><span>R · 2020</span></p>
    <h3>dimoose</h3>
    <p>R package for dichotomous identification keys. Build a key from a plain spreadsheet with photos, draw it as a box diagram, or turn it into an offline web wizard for the field; also imports FishBase keys and generates keys from photos (CLIP/BioCLIP), sequence alignments and trait matrices. Includes an illustrated key to Montana&#x27;s native broadleaf trees.</p>
  </div>
</a>
